name: thais-projeto-base
description: Painel de usuários — Angular + NestJS (projeto didático)

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start:dev --prefix api" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix api && npm run build --prefix frontend
